performance.verdict: No paid activity; 5 overdue SOW milestones now risk the renewal decision.

findings.text: Renewal closed 7/23 but scoreboard milestones — dashboard live, attribution gap, sync cleanup — all overdue as of 2026-08-31, threatening stay/walk decision.
Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved; 107 GHL opps created but 0 won and 0 appointments recorded — intake chain is unmeasurable.
Dashboard due 2026-08-31 is not live; client's explicit scoreboard (leads → scheduled → showed → new patients) cannot be reported, making renewal argument impossible.

GBP actions dropped 95.95% week-over-week (28-day total: 202 actions; last 4 days in series show 0). Daily verdict flagged a data gap — series confirms 4 consecutive zero-action days, not a single-day anomaly.
Search clicks fell 27.78% week-over-week; last 3 days avg 1.3 clicks vs prior-3-day avg of 4.7 — 3-day signal confirms softening organic search pull with zero paid support.
